task.title: Native Build 67 UPLOADED to App Store Connect, processing VALID

result.summary: Cut, archived, and uploaded Native Build 67 from the exact reviewed Command-Network-Diagnostics candidate (bd45edd6) with a build-number-only change -- no feature or behavioral change. This build carries the HTTP status code + response body size capture on every command attempt, and its display in Workout Reconciliation Diagnostics' new third section. Fresh validation: 1464/1464 unit tests, 13/13 UI tests, Release build succeeded, release-configuration verifier confirms version 1.0 (67). Archived with Xcode automatic signing, guarded upload dry-run passed every gate, real upload executed under Founder authorization: delivery id b29815a1-0d52-4cb1-80d4-b7c3976a0e51, processing VALID, independently reverified via a separate read-only status check.

tests.summary: Full PhysiqueOSTests target: 1464/1464 passing (1462 pre-existing + 2 new from the reviewed candidate). GoalsAcceptanceUITests + TrainingAcceptanceUITests: 13/13 passing, no regression.

review.summary: No new feature/behavioral code in this task beyond build-number metadata. The candidate itself (bd45edd6) was already fresh-context reviewed and one cosmetic issue fixed in the immediately prior task.

unexpected_findings: A full-scheme test invocation piped through `tail -60` accidentally discarded the unit-test target's output, showing only the UI target's summary. Caught before treating it as validation and re-ran the unit target explicitly with output captured to a file. Worth remembering: never pipe a long-running xcodebuild invocation through `tail` when the full pass/fail summary matters -- redirect to a file and grep it instead.
backlog: TestFlight tester-facing availability (beyond ASC processing VALID) is a separate, later Apple-side step not verified by the read-only status tool.

The Founder will personally perform exactly one Strength reconciliation acceptance attempt on Build 67 and capture the newly visible Command Network Diagnostics fields (HTTP status, body size, protocol, interface, timings) -- their own plan, not solicited by this task. No further attempt or workaround should be implemented by any future automated task until this evidence exists.

The exact infrastructure mechanism behind the prior server(nil) response (something ahead of the Next.js application) remains unconfirmed -- the new diagnostics in this build are what should finally make it identifiable.
The Server-side payload-reduction plan from an earlier report remains unimplemented.
recommended_next_step: Founder accepts Build 67 in TestFlight, performs one Strength reconciliation attempt, and captures the Command Network Diagnostics screen's fields (HTTP status, body size, protocol, interface, timings) alongside the existing Workout Reconciliation Diagnostics and Underlying Network Errors sections, regardless of success or failure.
